decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - Whether or not indicated on the drawings, all new openings in existing walls shall have the load path illustrated by way of nibs at former wall-ends and visible support beams.

Condition : 3 - Before the relevant part of the works are commenced, a scheme showing all roof finishes and drainage to new extensions laid to falls so that no additional surface water or splash shall affect the listed garden wall, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - Before the relevant part of the works are commenced, a scheme showing the final roof falls and finishes shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - Before the relevant part of the work is commenced, a scheme showing final details of the flue to the utility room, and the 'steam outlet' shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 6 - Before the relevant part of the work is commenced, sample panels of external brickwork shall be constructed on site showing bricks, bond, mortar material and joint style and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried outr in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - The exact position of the new facing wall to the proposed utility room shall be agreed on site, to retain as much as possible of the idiosyncratic angles along the front boundary wall face.

Condition : 8 - Before the relevant part of the work is commenced, joinery details and style of the proposed windows to be approved shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be in accordance with the approved details. Notwithstanding the drawings, the new window at FW9 shall be of a maximum overall structural width of 1.333 of proposed height, i.e. approx. 1.7m.

Condition : 9 - Various items including "steamer", proposed joinery hiding drainage and for built-in beds are noted. No surface finishes, or construction including areas of unventilated or poorly ventilated voids especially in areas of high or potentially high humidity are to be left adjacent to solid walls.
Condition : 10 - Final details of approved drawings should be added to this good 'log-book record' of the history of the building and earlier interventions.
description: Demolition of external stair on ground and first floor and erection of single storey rear extension. Demolition of front side staircase and erection of single storey front extension and new parapet wall. Demolition of small area of wall at first floor level and replacement of two sash windows with single window and replacement of existing double doors with a new sash window to rear of first floor to existing house.
